invariants: every chain binds source, target, ordered stages, candidate path, alternative paths, graph snapshot version and as_of
every edge binds source and target identity, event time, provenance kind, confidence, uncertainty and at least one evidence anchor
observed, derived and analyst edges remain distinguishable in storage, API and UI
derived or analyst edges can never be rendered or serialized as observed facts
path event time is nondecreasing; a time reversal fails closed rather than being reordered silently
a path cannot repeat a node or edge identity and cannot exceed the approved depth or result budget
contradictory paths are retained as alternatives with explicit uncertainty and never collapsed into one certain path
missing evidence makes the path partial; truncation exposes truncated=true, reason and continuation boundary
each edge can be traced to an event, rule, model or analyst conclusion and its immutable evidence reference
domain.compensation: withdraw the affected derived snapshot, retain observed facts and analyst history, restore the prior graph snapshot, and rebuild bounded paths from the retained source watermarks

negative_tests: cross-tenant source, target, path, edge or evidence reference is rejected
over-depth, cyclic, time-reversed and evidence-free paths are rejected
a derived edge labelled observed is rejected
contradictory alternatives cannot be discarded without an analyst revision and audit

stop_conditions: path budget truncation is hidden, query P99 or Nebula PROFILE budget exceeds the approved candidate, source watermarks or evidence hashes diverge

tests: G1 path shape, provenance, time ordering and tenant isolation
G2 over-depth, cycle, reverse-time, missing-evidence and contradiction negatives
G3 same-snapshot ClickHouse, NebulaGraph, PostgreSQL and MinIO assembly
G4 count, hash, watermark and per-edge evidence reconciliation
G5 K8s canary, rollback and observation
evidence: candidate-bound graph snapshot, exact node and edge sets, primary and alternative path hashes, per-edge evidence manifest, truncation report, rollback receipt and observation window
